verdict.rationale: Omarchy's own docs say graphics drivers and configuration, including NVIDIA on supported hardware, are set up during installation. That covers the GPU-driver half of the story, though only in a gaming context. Nothing in the pack shows support for building custom kernel modules (DKMS, kernel headers) or setting up GPU compute or accelerated workloads. missing for 10: documented custom kernel module building, GPU compute/acceleration stack setup (e.g. CUDA/ROCm), driver installation beyond install-time and 'supported hardware', independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install GPU vendor drivers and build custom kernel modules for accelerated workloads

citations.quote: Graphics drivers and configuration, including NVIDIA on supported hardware, are sorted during installation.
